text:
alice-support: Customer reported intermittent 504s from Hosted API when sending streaming /v1/generate requests, started ~08:20 UTC. Customer says it began after a routine token rotation. Sample trace IDs: trace=trc_21a3, trc_21a4, trc_21a5

alice-support: Example curl they used (redacted):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Customer-Billing: cust-777" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"gpt-xl","stream":true}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2025-03-18T07:50:12Z -> hostedapi/edge-proxy v2.14 rolled

bob-eng-sre: can you paste the edge logs for trace trc_21a3? also which region/customer tier?

alice-support: customer in prod-us-east, paid tier. copying logs (sanitized):
```
[envoy] 2025-03-18T08:20:05Z conn_id=987 upstream_request_complete code=504 upstream_response_time=30.521s peer=10.1.5.23:8080 "POST /v1/generate"
[nginx] 2025-03-18T08:20:05Z *124356 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 54.12.34.56
```

alice-support: note: upstream here is authz-service -> which validates billing + tenant, then proxies to model-router. Authz logs show a backlog of auth requests and high latency (p95 ~28s)

carol-support: quick repro attempt locally: when I replay with the X-Customer-Billing header it reproduces 504s consistently. Without header (guest flow) it responds fine. Could be billing lookup throttling authz.

dave-eng-platform: possible root causes: authz DB cold cache after token rotation, authz service per-tenant rate limit, or connection pool exhaustion to billing backend. Also check keepalive settings between envoy and authz.

bob-eng-sre: grabbing traces. t=trc_21a3 shows envoy sent request to authz, authz did a synchronous HTTP call to billing API, billing API returned 503 intermittently, authz timed out after 25s and returned 502 to envoy which translated to 504 at the edge.

bob-eng-sre: partial trace snippet:
```
Envoy -> authz-service POST /authorize (client_ctx)
authz-service -> billing-api GET /tenant/cust-777/limits (latency 18-30s, intermittent 503)
authz-service times out (30s) -> returns upstream_error
```

alice-support: customer reports spike coincided with a billing maintenance window earlier. They said some billing nodes were rotated.

dave-eng-platform: mitigation options:
- increase envoy upstream timeout to 60s as temporary bandage
- add circuit-breaker on authz-to-billing calls with cached fallback on 5xx
- make billing lookup async / cached for streaming start (allow response without fresh billing check)

carol-support: fast mitigation I can apply now: route this customer's requests to hostedapi-dedicated (we have reserved path) or throttle billing lookups for known-good customers. Which is lower risk?

bob-eng-sre: please do NOT move traffic to dedicated without approval. I'll try quick config change: bump envoy idle_timeout and upstream_read_timeout from 30s -> 45s for region prod-us-east for authz route, and enable proxy-retry=0 for that route to avoid retry amplification.

alice-support: applied change to staging (prod-us-east staged rollout). Replaying same curl now shows stream begins after 1.2s and continues. Need to monitor for a few minutes before full rollout.

deploy-bot: staged config rollout started 2025-03-18T08:46:00Z

bob-eng-sre: follow-up root fix: engineering to implement cached billing response (ttl 5m) and resilient billing client with limited concurrency. Assigning to @dave-eng-platform and @zoe-backend.

dave-eng-platform: acked, creating ticket PLAT-4821 for cached fallback + connection-pool tuning. I'll also add metrics for billing 5xx ratio and authz latency spike alerts.

alice-support: customer notified: "We traced this to billing maintenance causing authz timeouts; we've staged an edge config change and are working on a permanent fix. We'll follow up with timeline." :eyes:

carol-support: monitoring: zero 504s for the staged cohort over last 10 minutes. rolling to 50% now.

bob-eng-sre: notes for postmortem:
- trigger: billing backend rotation during high churn + token rotation
- propagation: authz sync billing check on every stream start -> high latency -> upstream timeout -> envoy surfaces 504
- short-term: increased timeouts and disabled retries for route
- long-term: cache billing responses, async checks, implement graceful fallback

alice-support: closing thread after PLAT-4821 created and customer confirmed short-term fix. will reopen if 504s recur. :white_check_mark:

participants: alice-support, bob-eng-sre, carol-support, dave-eng-platform, deploy-bot
